description: ADCOS Federation object: a typed relationship between administrative domains allowing selected capabilities and services to be shared (spec/architecture.md §6.10). Required properties encode the federation-relationship specification list of §21. Federation is not equivalent to trust of every node in a peer domain: trust is scoped to explicitly granted capabilities and policies. Lifecycle and inter-domain protocol behavior are owned by WORK-015.

resource_exposure.description: Which resources are exposed across the federation boundary.

revocation_semantics.description: How federation trust can be revoked; removal must not require deleting local state (WORK-015).

service_exposure.description: Which services are exposed across the federation boundary.

settlement_policy.description: Economic settlement policy; deliberately opaque here — billing/token systems must not be imported into routing semantics (architecture §17).

shared_capabilities.description: Capability identifiers shared across the federation boundary.

trust_policy.description: Scoped trust policy for this relationship.

title: ADCOS Federation
